title: Voice and sign-in

content:
Voice and sign-in

Transcription and cloud voice endpoints expect an authenticated session; document the “please sign in” case.

What this is

Voice transcription and cloud voice endpoints expect you to be signed in to Kahana. Unsigned users see a sign-in prompt instead of results.

How to use it

  • Complete Kahana auth before testing voice.
  • If you signed out mid-session, re-auth and reopen the mic.
  • Enterprise proxies must allow the voice endpoint domain (see your admin guide).

Notes and limits

Local-only experimental features may exist in developer builds; production follows cloud rules.
